notes.title: Demo version and future plans
notes.notes:
Well, radio silence is temporarily over and it is high time we told you something.

Firstly, a test build of the new winter episode is ready and has been incorporated in the game.

The build features the following:
1.New sprites of the main character and NPC (from remaining source-codes)
2. New mechanics (beat ‘em up, stash)
3. Cool episode background
4. jokes and gags

Just download the update and check it out.
Saves are working, how could it be otherwise?

Secondly, we would like to compliment everybody who shared our call for help. It was thanks to you that more that 10 people joined our team. Among them are artists, programmers and simply fun guys, eyes ablaze with enthusiasm. Due to the present circumstances, we must pause, albeit, involuntarily, the development of Wicked Games. This doesn’t mean our brain child has been dumped or back-burnered. We will definitely come back when we have enough drive and opportunities. 

Sibcat Team isn’t quitting game development – quite the opposite. With the advent of fresh and boiling blood our renewed team has taken up working on a brand-new project in the same universe.

All this time hasn’t been wasted: we have come up with conception, organized working relations, determined the plot, visuals and gameplay features.
A part of material is ready, now we’re writing the script, have launched recoding. Also, we are drawing sketches of new locations and characters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42650227/574cabb3b0224c971e3246649e29383f0d1966ed.png
Yes, you got us right – we are deliberately avoiding being specific and waffling; suspense is ought to have presence, after all. But there is a concrete purpose for that.
Stay tuned, brothers and sisters, for announcement of a new, with whole peanuts and chocolate, game, is approaching. 

You see, even pretentious pathos is here.

Follow our Discord channel to stay in touch.

We embrace you all and thank you for your support.

notes.title: Release and thanks!
notes.notes:
This day has become very important to our team.

We have finally released the demo-version in Steam and got positive feedback.
There are more than 1 000 people added our game to their libraries.

These emotions are thanks to you!

The third level is in production, some parts of the visual content are already completed, and we do hope the update won't be long!

Join our Discord-channel to stay in touch and follow all the upcoming updates!

Cheers!

notes.title: The release date & important info
notes.notes:
Hello everybody and thank you for your attention!

The demo-version of the game will be released in 27th of July.
Our small team have passed through a lot of challenges to reach this moment and we are incredibly happy to share our product with you.
We hope you enjoy our demo and stay in touch with us up to new updates!

How to contact us?
Join our Discord channel

There you can find information about the upcoming updates, chat with us and other members of the community and have fun!

Also if you want to get some extra and exclusive content of the development process you can visit our Boosty page.
All the links are on our Discord server.

Thank you again, much love babes.
